Kelsey (CS Ops): kicking off a short dedupe sprint this afternoon. i exported top ~200 fuzzy matches to the doc (view-only): https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/1newSheetLink - sheet has filters for renewal_quarter and last_activity days.
Maya (CS): nice, quick question  is the export excluding active Q4 renewals? don't want to accidentally merge accounts near renewal
Kelsey (CS Ops): yep excluded Q4. filter col G = renewal_quarter. i'm only touching Q1-Q3 and accounts with last_activity > 60 days unless owners confirm.
Sanjay (Data Eng): heads up the owner backfill job errored on ~42 rows. error: `ERROR: foreign key violation inserting into account_owners (user_id not found)`. i've added an "owner-failures" tab in the sheet with the problem rows.
Ravi (CS Manager): can you output those rows to CSV so we can run an owner hunt? i'll assign owners for high-ACV ones.
Tom (Onboarding): i'll triage any rows where onboarding_status = "in_progress"  likely keep current owner.
Kelsey (CS Ops): added heuristic owner_suggestions in the csv. @Maya can you sanity-check the 8 flagged as possible pod changes? mark anything to `DEFER`.
Maya (CS): will review today; plan to move clear matches to `confirm-owner`. anything ambiguous i'll mark `defer` and ping the CE.
playbook-bot: Reminder: playbook automation deploy scheduled 1600 UTC. dry-run merges will execute in the sandbox first. :gear:
Kelsey (CS Ops): playbook rules being applied (summary):
- merge only when `match_score >= 0.89`
- skip merges if `open_support_tickets > 0`
- attach audit note tag `csops:dedupe-2026-06` to the surviving record
Sanjay (Data Eng): updated SQL for match calculations; `match_signal` now replaces `legacy_score`. example: `SELECT id, match_score, match_signal FROM crm_matches WHERE match_score >= 0.7;`
Maya (CS): reviewed 40 rows so far  moved 14 to `confirm-owner`, 12 to `defer` (notes in the sheet), and 14 left for automation dry-run.
Kelsey (CS Ops): plan after manual triage:
1) dry-run playbook on the 14 automated candidates
2) if dry-run clean, proceed to live merges in controlled batches (20/hr)
3) send owner notifications + append audit notes
Ravi (CS Manager): add an extra pre-merge check: if `renewal_probability < 0.6` AND ACV > 50k, escalate to AE ops for manual review before merging.
Tom (Onboarding): will flag onboarding accounts in the sheet with `onboard_owner` and ping the relevant AEs.
Maya (CS): small note: we observed a healthscore drift for a subset of accounts tied to last_30d_activity. @Sanjay can you add a nightly recompute for that segment and surface a delta report?
Sanjay (Data Eng): can do. i'll add a scheduled job and attach a runbook. expect PR and schedule by EOD. i'll also patch the owner backfill to log unknown_user_ids for easier triage.
Kelsey (CS Ops): action items recap:
- @Maya complete owner confirmations (by today 18:00)
- @Sanjay schedule healthscore recompute + fix backfill bug
- @Tom map onboarding-owner handoffs for `defer` cases
- @Ravi draft AE ops escalation template (one-liner + link to row)
I'll post a final go/no-go after the dry-run. :rocket:
Maya (CS): done with confirmations, left 2 accounts with open tickets as manual review. moving forward for dry-run.
playbook-bot: Dry-run finished  14 proposed merges, 0 conflicts, 2 flagged for `open_support_tickets`. audit log: https://internal.redwood.ai/playbook/logs/1768129999
Kelsey (CS Ops): dry-run looks clean. holding live merges until AE-escalation checks are added. if no blockers, i'll start live merges at 21:00 UTC in batches and post summaries after each batch.
Tom (Onboarding): i'll standby for the 2 support-ticket cases (likely onboarding blockers) and assist with owner confirmation if needed.
Ravi (CS Manager): also want to capture AE feedback after escalations  let's add a tiny feedback form and include link in the escalation message.
Kelsey (CS Ops): done  created short survey and added link to sheet notes. starting batch at 21:00 if all good. will post merge IDs and audit tags when complete. thanks all :clap:
